title: Remove normative "Space owner" row from FileNode permissions table
description:
File: draft-atwood-jmap-chat-filenode-00.md
Location: line 153 (inside the permissions table at lines 147-153)

Current text:
| Member with `"manage_space"` | Read + Create + Delete + Administer: manage ACLs, rename the tree root |
| Space owner                      | Full access (equivalent to Administer) |

The "Space owner" row contradicts c93e545's impl-defined governance posture in the main draft. It is also redundant: any controller principal designated under §Space Governance: Deployment Variation will reach Administer-level FileNode access via `manage_space` (or via the implicit-all-permissions bypass described at the new line 1415 of the main draft), so the row adds no behavior.

Note: the surrounding text at filenode 141-144 already correctly defers to the main draft's role/permission model. Only the row in the table is the bug.

Reference: §Space Governance: Deployment Variation in draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00.md.
acceptance_criteria:
- "Space owner" row removed from the permissions table at filenode line 153
- No replacement row needed (the existing `manage_space` row plus the controller-principal bypass in the main draft already cover the case)
- grep for 'Space owner' in the filenode draft returns zero matches
- Acceptance grep across the whole corpus: 'Space owner' should appear nowhere except possibly inside §Space Governance: Deployment Variation prose in the main draft (which uses 'controller' as the term of art)
